name: Master Multi-Domain Investigation Decision Tree Knowledge Graph

nodes.name: Triage Agent
nodes.description: Master entry point: ingests incident ticket, performs triage classification, and routes investigation to the appropriate domain decision tree

nodes.name: Prompt Result (LOGIN Domain): Affected User, Division/LOB, Mirror User, Login URL
nodes.description: Initial entry point for LOGIN domain decision tree: Ingests Prompt Result containing Affected User, Division / LOB, Mirror User, and Login URL

nodes.name: Login URL Provided?
nodes.description: Check whether the incident narrative contains a specific login URL

nodes.name: Validate Login URL
nodes.description: Validate login URL against approved Salesforce MyDomain patterns

nodes.name: Approved URL?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the validated URL is an approved corporate MyDomain

nodes.name: Search user in main org
nodes.swimlane: User not found in any org
nodes.description: Search the primary Salesforce org for the target user identity

nodes.name: Matching User Found in Main Org?
nodes.swimlane: User not found in any org
nodes.description: Evaluate if the user record was resolved in the main Salesforce org

nodes.name: Search User in other orgs
nodes.swimlane: User not found in any org
nodes.description: Search auxiliary and secondary enterprise Salesforce orgs

nodes.name: Matching User Found in Other Orgs?
nodes.swimlane: User not found in any org
nodes.description: Evaluate if the user was found in any secondary or regional org

nodes.name: Fetch salesforce user (Is Active?)
nodes.description: Inspect the IsActive attribute on the resolved Salesforce user record

nodes.name: Is Active?
nodes.description: Check if user IsActive is True or False in Salesforce

nodes.name: Retrieve Deactivation Audit
nodes.description: Inspect SetupAuditTrail and retrieve latest user deactivation entries; retrieve Delegated Administrator members from DelegateGroupMember

nodes.name: Deactivation actor matches DelegateGroupMember?
nodes.description: Compare SetupAuditTrail.CreatedById with DelegateGroupMember.UserOrGroupId

nodes.name: Fetch Similar User using mirror user identity
nodes.description: Fetch peer mirror user to establish identity comparison baseline

nodes.name: Compare EmpId and Federation Id of mirror user
nodes.description: Compare Employee ID, license type, and Federation ID against peer mirror user benchmark

nodes.name: Is same? (Internal)
nodes.description: Determine if user identity is internal corporate employee vs external partner

nodes.name: Federation ID Blank?
nodes.description: Check if Salesforce FederationIdentifier is null, empty or unpopulated

nodes.name: Federation ID has Suspended value?
nodes.description: Check if Identity Provider / Okta user status is SUSPENDED or frozen

nodes.name: Federation ID matches Emp ID? (Workday)
nodes.description: Verify Salesforce FederationIdentifier matches Workday Employee ID in Azure AD

nodes.name: Has Description contain 'Mobile Login Issue' Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident symptoms describe mobile app client configuration

nodes.name: Federation ID matches Emp ID? (CIAM)
nodes.description: Check if external user synthetic identity matches CIAM mapping

nodes.name: Is Email Verified?
nodes.description: Check if Salesforce User EmailVerified attribute is True

nodes.name: Has Description contain 'Work Order Email Not Received' Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident symptoms report missing work order notification emails

nodes.name: Confirmed Wrong Salesforce URL
nodes.decision_basis: User account exists in Main Org, but attempted to access via an unapproved or incorrect URL. Provide official Main Org URL (https://bdx.my.salesforce.com) and verify resolution.
nodes.expected_criteria: Login via approved company MyDomain URL

nodes.name: Confirmed User not found in any org
nodes.swimlane: User not found in any org
nodes.decision_basis: User account could not be located in primary org or any registered secondary org. Incident ticket is rerouted directly to HCL Service Desk for further handling (no RITM required from caller).
nodes.expected_criteria: User account exists in Salesforce

nodes.name: Confirmed User found in another org
nodes.decision_basis: User account was located in an alternate enterprise organization. Update work notes with identified org and approved login URL, and reroute to dedicated regional support team.
nodes.expected_criteria: User account provisioned in Primary Org

nodes.name: Confirmed User Deactivated by Delegated Administrator
nodes.decision_basis: User exists in NA org AND IsActive = False. Deactivated user identified in SetupAuditTrail and SetupAuditTrail.CreatedById matches DelegateGroupMember.UserOrGroupId. Inform user to raise Manage User RITM for account reactivation.
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA org AND IsActive = False AND SetupAuditTrail.CreatedById matches DelegateGroupMember.UserOrGroupId

nodes.name: Automated deactivation from MuleSoft integration process
nodes.decision_basis: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = False AND SetupAuditTrail.CreatedById = MuleSoft Integration User. Investigate deactivation reason with MuleSoft team, review payload/Kibana logs, engage Workday team if required, and update work notes with findings.
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = False AND SetupAuditTrail.CreatedById = MuleSoft Integration User

nodes.name: Confirmed Federation ID Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND Internal User AND FederationIdentifier IS NULL or Blank. Update FederationIdentifier with EmployeeNumber.
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND Internal User AND FederationIdentifier IS NULL or Blank

nodes.name: Confirmed Federation ID Suspended
nodes.decision_basis: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND Internal User AND FederationIdentifier contains suspended/frozen. Inform user to raise Manage User RITM for FederationIdentifier correction.
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND Internal User AND FederationIdentifier contains suspended/frozen

nodes.name: Confirmed Azure Federation ID Synchronization Issue
nodes.decision_basis: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND Internal User AND FederationIdentifier IS NOT NULL AND FederationIdentifier != EmployeeNumber. Engage Azure Team for validation and synchronization.
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND Internal User AND FederationIdentifier IS NOT NULL AND FederationIdentifier != EmployeeNumber

nodes.name: Confirmed CIAM synthetic identity mapping issue
nodes.decision_basis: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND External User AND FederationIdentifier requires CIAM validation. Engage CIAM Team for validation and synchronization.
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND External User AND FederationIdentifier requires CIAM validation

nodes.name: Confirmed Mobile Login Setup Issue
nodes.decision_basis: User account is active and operational; symptoms describe client-side mobile application configuration.
nodes.expected_criteria: User.IsActive == True AND symptom indicates mobile login configuration

nodes.name: Confirmed Work Order Email Issue
nodes.decision_basis: Missing email notifications upon work order closure due to email verification settings on Work Order.
nodes.expected_criteria: Deliverability enabled for Work Order notifications

nodes.name: Confirmed Email not verified
nodes.decision_basis: Salesforce User account email address is unverified, blocking portal and SSO login.
nodes.expected_criteria: User.EmailVerified == True

nodes.name: Out Of Scope
nodes.decision_basis: User verified active with valid credentials, verified email, and valid Federation ID. No canonical login issue matched flowchart criteria. Routing to Tier-2 engineering.
nodes.expected_criteria: Standard canonical diagnostic pattern

nodes.name: Check User Existence for Unapproved URL
nodes.description: Verify if the user account exists in the Main Salesforce Organization despite using an unapproved URL

nodes.name: User Exists in Main Org? (Unapproved URL)
nodes.description: Determine if user account exists in Main Org (NA) when an unapproved URL was used

nodes.name: Provided URL Belongs to Main Org?
nodes.description: Determine whether the approved URL belongs to the Main Organization (NA: bdx) or a secondary cross-org

nodes.name: Search User in Provided Secondary Org
nodes.description: Search the specific secondary organization (EMEA/ACE/SMAX) corresponding to the provided approved URL

nodes.name: User Exists in Provided Secondary Org?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the user account exists in the specific organization associated with the provided URL

nodes.name: Search Main Org for Misdirected User
nodes.description: Search Main Org (NA) to verify if a user who entered a cross-org URL actually belongs to the Main Org

nodes.name: User Exists in Main Org? (Cross-Org Link)
nodes.description: Evaluate if user who entered a cross-org URL actually holds an account in the Main Organization (NA)

nodes.name: Confirmed Regional Org Scope (Reroute)
nodes.decision_basis: User account exists in the regional organization matching the provided URL. Ticket falls under dedicated regional team scope; rerouted to regional support team.
nodes.expected_criteria: User account in regional organization

nodes.name: Confirmed Main Org User Used Cross-Org URL
nodes.decision_basis: User account exists in Main Org (NA), but user attempted to log in using a cross-org endpoint. Provide official Main Org URL (https://bdx.my.salesforce.com).
nodes.expected_criteria: User accesses Main Org URL (bdx.my.salesforce.com)

nodes.name: Prompt Result (APPLICATION Domain): Affected User, Domain: Application, Mirror User, Login URL
nodes.description: Initial entry point for APPLICATION domain decision tree: Ingests Prompt Result containing Affected User, Domain: Application, Mirror User, and Login URL

nodes.name: Follow Login flowchart to find IsActive
nodes.description: Follow Login flowchart to verify user existence and active status in NA org

nodes.name: Is Active ?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the affected user account is active in Salesforce

nodes.name: Login Issue
nodes.decision_basis: User account is deactivated (IsActive=False). Issue is governed by the Login domain deactivation workflow.
nodes.expected_criteria: User.IsActive == True

nodes.name: Retrieve Assigned Permission sets and details
nodes.description: Retrieve all assigned Permission Sets, package licenses, and user permissions from Salesforce

nodes.name: Classify the IssueType
nodes.description: Classify target application based on ticket description (CC360, Pharma/Community, Conga/CLM/Apttus)

nodes.name: CC360 Issue?
nodes.description: Check whether the incident concerns Customer 360 (CC360 / Cloud Customer 360)

nodes.name: Pharm App Issue?
nodes.description: Check whether the incident concerns Pharma System or Community application

nodes.name: Conga App Issue?
nodes.description: Check whether the incident concerns Conga / CLM / Apttus application suite

nodes.name: Is CC360 Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.description: Verify if CC360 Permission Set (e.g. Cloud Customer 360 / CC360_User) is assigned to the user

nodes.name: Confirmed: CC360 Permission Set Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User is active, issue is classified as CC360, but user lacks CC360 Permission Set in Salesforce.
nodes.expected_criteria: CC360 Permission Set assigned to user

nodes.name: Is Only PS Community User Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.swimlane: Only PS Community Permission Set Missing
nodes.description: Verify if 'Only PS Community User' (or Pharma Community User) permission set is assigned to user

nodes.name: Confirmed: Only PS Community User Permission Set Missing
nodes.swimlane: Only PS Community Permission Set Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User is active and attempting to access Pharma/Community app, but 'Only PS Community User' permission set is missing from user record.
nodes.expected_criteria: Only PS Community User Permission Set assigned

nodes.name: Classify the IssueType / Analyse the Incident Description
nodes.description: Analyze incident narrative for specific Conga sub-symptoms (CLM Onboarding, CRM Content, X-Author, BU, Apttus access)

nodes.name: Has Description contains "CLM New User Onboarding Issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident narrative contains CLM new user onboarding or setup symptoms

nodes.name: Is CLM Package Assigned?
nodes.description: Inspect UserPackageLicense to verify if Conga CLM / Apttus package license is assigned

nodes.name: Confirmed: CLM Package License Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User experiencing CLM New User Onboarding issue, and Conga CLM Package License (UserPackageLicense) is missing in Salesforce.
nodes.expected_criteria: Conga CLM Package License assigned

nodes.name: Has Description contained "CRM Content / Content Library Issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if ticket description mentions CRM Content / Content Library access errors

nodes.name: Is UserPermissionsContentUser Enabled?
nodes.description: Check whether User.UserPermissionsSFContentUser is True in Salesforce

nodes.name: Confirmed: CRM Content User Not Enabled
nodes.decision_basis: User requires CRM Content / Content Library access, but UserPermissionsSFContentUser is False on their Salesforce user record.
nodes.expected_criteria: User.UserPermissionsSFContentUser == True

nodes.name: Has Description contained "X-Author related issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if description mentions Conga X-Author, X-Author for Excel, or contract template add-in

nodes.name: Is Agreement - Apttus X-Author Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.description: Verify whether Apttus / Conga X-Author Permission Set is assigned to the user

nodes.name: Confirmed: X-Author Permission Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User experiencing X-Author issue, and Apttus X-Author Permission Set is missing from user record in Salesforce.
nodes.expected_criteria: Agreement - Apttus X-Author Permission Set assigned

nodes.name: Determine BU and Access Level from Description
nodes.description: Determine whether Business Unit (BU) and Access Level are present and valid in user profile or ticket narrative

nodes.name: Confirmed: BU Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User's Business Unit (BU) or Access Level cannot be determined or is missing in Salesforce configuration.
nodes.expected_criteria: Valid Business Unit and Access Level configured

nodes.name: Has Description contained "Permission or Access issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if description mentions general Apttus/Conga agreement permission or access errors

nodes.name: Is Agreement - Apttus Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.description: Verify whether Agreement - Apttus / Conga Permission Set is assigned to user

nodes.name: Confirmed: Apttus Permission Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User experiencing Apttus agreement permission or access issue, and Agreement Apttus Permission Set is missing from Salesforce.
nodes.expected_criteria: Agreement - Apttus Permission Set assigned

nodes.name: L3 Group Resolver
nodes.decision_basis: All checked permissions and package licenses are already assigned in Salesforce. Escalated to L3 Group Resolver for specialized analysis.
nodes.expected_criteria: Application permissions present

nodes.name: L3 Queue Resolver
nodes.decision_basis: Reported application issue is not CC360, Pharma, or recognized Conga symptoms. Ticket routed to L3 Queue Resolver.
nodes.expected_criteria: Recognized application scope

nodes.name: Is Application Domain?
nodes.description: Determine whether ticket belongs to APPLICATION domain vs LOGIN domain after verifying user exists and is active in NA org

nodes.name: Route by Incident Domain
nodes.description: User exists and is active in NA Org. Route to corresponding domain deep diagnosis node based on ticket domain: LOGIN, APPLICATION, RECORD, or OBJECT

nodes.name: Login Domain
nodes.description: Proceed to LOGIN domain deep diagnosis: evaluate SSO identity, mirror user, and FederationIdentifier

nodes.name: Application Domain
nodes.description: Proceed to APPLICATION domain deep diagnosis: evaluate CC360, Pharma, Conga CLM package, CRM Content, X-Author, BU, and Apttus BU permission sets

nodes.name: Record Domain
nodes.description: Proceed to RECORD domain deep diagnosis: evaluate report/dashboard, opportunity/case, and record access

nodes.name: Object Domain
nodes.description: Proceed to OBJECT domain deep diagnosis: evaluate Wizard app access, object CRUD permissions, and Product Search

nodes.label: Classify the Issue Type
nodes.description: Analyze incident description and extract Object symptoms (Wizard App/Product Search, Object Access, Field Access)

nodes.label: Has Description contained 'Wizard App or Product Search Issue' Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident mentions Wizard App or Product Search

nodes.label: Retrieve Contact Record
nodes.description: Query Contact record linked to the affected user and check Wizard_Country__c

nodes.label: Is Wizard_Country__c Blank?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the Wizard_Country__c field on Contact is null or empty

nodes.label: Confirmed: Wizard_Country__c is blank
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: Contact Wizard_Country__c field is missing/blank, blocking Wizard App and Product Search

nodes.label: Has Description contained 'Object or Field Access Issue' Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident mentions Object Access or Field Access symptoms

nodes.label: Is Object Access Issue?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the issue pertains to Object-level CRUD permissions

nodes.label: Confirmed: Object Access Issue
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks required Object CRUD permissions on profile or permission sets (ObjectPermissions differ from mirror user)

nodes.label: Is Field Access Issue?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the issue pertains to Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions

nodes.label: Confirmed: Field Access Issue
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks required Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions (FieldPermissions differ from mirror user)

nodes.label: Manual Review
nodes.description: Object issue investigation inconclusive. Route for L2 manual review.

nodes.label: Out Of Scope
nodes.description: Incident symptoms do not match Object domain criteria. Escalate or reclassify.

nodes.name: Classify the Issue Type
nodes.description: Analyze incident description and extract Record symptoms (Report/Dashboard, Opportunity/Case, Salesforce Record, FLS)

nodes.name: Report/Dashboard?
nodes.description: Check if incident relates to Report or Dashboard access

nodes.name: Check Object Permissions (Report/Dashboard)
nodes.description: Inspect object permissions for Report and Dashboard objects

nodes.name: Missing Object Permissions?
nodes.description: Evaluate if user lacks required Report/Dashboard object permissions

nodes.name: Confirmed: Missing Object Permissions
nodes.description: User lacks required Object permissions on Report or Dashboard

nodes.name: Is Folder Info Available?
nodes.description: Check if Folder ID or folder path is identified in the incident narrative

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: Folder information not available in incident description. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: Check Folder Access (User/Public Groups/Roles)
nodes.description: Check whether user, public groups, or roles have access to the report/dashboard folder

nodes.name: Folder Access Missing?
nodes.description: Evaluate if user lacks Viewer, Editor, or Manager access to the Folder

nodes.name: Confirmed: Folder Access Missing
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks folder access to the target Report/Dashboard folder

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: Folder access is granted but user still reports issue. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: Opportunity/Case?
nodes.description: Check if incident relates to Opportunity or Case record access

nodes.name: Check Object Permissions (Opp/Case)
nodes.description: Inspect user profile and permission sets for Opportunity and Case object permissions

nodes.name: Missing Object Permissions?
nodes.description: Evaluate if user lacks required Opportunity or Case object permissions

nodes.name: Confirmed: Missing Object Permissions
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks object-level Read or Create permissions for Opportunity or Case

nodes.name: Cannot Access Record?
nodes.description: Check if user symptom is inability to access/open the specific Opportunity or Case record

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: Opportunity/Case record is accessible. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: HasReadAccess?
nodes.description: Check UserRecordAccess.HasReadAccess for the Opportunity or Case record

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: User already has read access on Opportunity/Case record. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: Review Owner, OWD, Role Hierarchy, Sharing Rules, Groups, Teams, Queues, Territories and Manual Sharing
nodes.description: Audit full record sharing hierarchy for the Opportunity or Case record

nodes.name: Missing Sharing Path?
nodes.description: Confirm whether user has no active sharing path to the Opportunity or Case

nodes.name: Confirmed: Missing Record Sharing
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks record sharing for Opportunity or Case record

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: Sharing path exists but user unable to access Opportunity/Case. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: Salesforce Record?
nodes.description: Check if incident pertains to a Salesforce object record

nodes.name: Out Of Scope
nodes.description: Incident narrative does not relate to a Salesforce Record. Out of scope.

nodes.name: Check Required Object Permissions using Affected Record ID
nodes.description: Identify object from record ID and verify user's object-level permissions

nodes.name: Missing Permissions?
nodes.description: Evaluate if user lacks required Object CRUD permissions

nodes.name: Confirmed: Missing Object Permissions
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks object-level Read or Create permissions for the target record type

nodes.name: Cannot Access Record?
nodes.description: Check if user symptom is inability to access/open the record

nodes.name: HasReadAccess?
nodes.description: Check UserRecordAccess.HasReadAccess for the target record

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: User already has read access on record. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: Review Owner, OWD, Role Hierarchy, Sharing Rules, Groups, Teams, Queues, Territories and Manual Sharing
nodes.description: Perform full sharing audit across OWD, Role Hierarchy, Sharing Rules, Public Groups, and Teams

nodes.name: Missing Sharing Path?
nodes.description: Confirm if no active sharing path grants user access to this record

nodes.name: Confirmed: Missing Record Sharing
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: Missing record sharing (OWD is Private and no sharing rules or team assignment grant access)

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: Sharing path exists for record. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: Field Not Visible/Editable?
nodes.description: Check if user can open record but reports a field is not visible or not editable

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: Field visibility/editability issue not confirmed. Route for manual review.

nodes.name: Compare Mirror user and Review Field Permissions
nodes.description: Compare field permissions between affected user and baseline mirror user

nodes.name: FLS Missing?
nodes.description: Evaluate if Field-Level Security permission is missing on user Profile or Permission Sets

nodes.name: Confirmed: Missing FLS
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: Missing Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions on target field

nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.description: FLS is present for user. Route for manual review.

edges.description: Route ticket classified as LOGIN domain to Login decision tree
Route ticket classified as APPLICATION domain to Application decision tree
Application flow follows login mainflow: search user in NA main org
User confirmed active in NA Org -> Route by incident domain
Active user in NA org -> Proceed to Login domain
Active user in NA org -> Proceed to Application domain
Active user in NA org -> Proceed to Record domain
Active user in NA org -> Proceed to Object domain
Enter Login domain deep diagnosis: fetch mirror user and evaluate SSO / Federation ID
Enter Application domain deep diagnosis: retrieve permission sets, licenses, and BU groups
Enter Record domain deep diagnosis: classify record issue
Enter Object domain deep diagnosis: classify issue type
